name: nuxt-vat
description: EU VAT number validation for Nuxt: format checks, VIES lookup with caching, and auto-imported composables for client and server.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && nuxt dev playground
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt prepare playground
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run prepack && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:types: vue-tsc --noEmit && vue-tsc --noEmit -p src/runtime/server/tsconfig.json && cd playground && vue-tsc --noEmit
